in_hebrew.name: Alben
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend or Nobleman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alben הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'Albus' meaning 'white' or 'noble'. In ancient Rome, the name 'Alben' was given to a friend or a nobleman. In Christianity, it is a rare name and is not directly associated with any biblical figure.

in_latin.name: Alben
in_latin.meaning: Latin name possibly derived from albus, 'white' or 'fair'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Latinum putatur a albus, 'albus' vel 'fairus' derivari. Historically, nomen Christianum in Ecclesia Christiana usus est, sed nunc rarius invenitur.
